instruction.text: Read each paragraph about sports. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: This is a game that is very popular globally. It involves kicking a ball. The aim is to score a goal.
This activity takes place in water, usually a pool, and can be done competitively or for leisure. People tend to do this on holiday.
There are many ways this activity can be done. One popular style is ballet, but this isn’t the only style.

instruction.text: Read each paragraph about school subjects. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: People can find this topic quite tricky because it uses lots of numbers. This topic is very important though.
This subject can be very exciting and uses experiments to describe the world. There are different topics in this subject, such as chemistry, physics and biology.
This subject teaches you a new language. Some people have a pen-pal to improve their language skills.

instruction.text: Read each paragraph about body parts. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: This is a body part inside our mouth. They are used for chewing food. You should brush them twice each day.
This body part is on the lower half of our bodies. They help us to walk and run.
This body part helps us to see things. They come in different colours, but the most common colours are blue and brown.

instruction.text: Read each paragraph about drinks. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: This is a clear, fizzy drink that is nice on a hot day with ice.
This is a warm drink that is very common in Britain especially. It can be drunk plain, with milk or with sugar.
This can be drunk, but a lot of people also eat it with cereal.
